purpose: Start a project-owned original structured sound substrate factory after Batch 006 was acceptable but still not foundational enough.
factoryRule: Generate reusable low-level harmonic substrates from deterministic synthesis, then later arrange them into finished sound journeys.

stems.title: Sleep Dark Substrate 001
stems.designIntent: A dark, low, non-melodic sleep substrate that can sit underneath future sleep journeys without sounding cheerful or song-like.
stems.structure: dim entry -> low-body settlement -> gradual descent -> stable night floor

stems.title: Calm Breathing Field 001
stems.designIntent: A warm breath-like harmonic field where the sense of inhale/exhale comes from slow gain motion, not from hiss or white-noise texture.
stems.structure: warm presence -> wider breathing field -> one gentle settling wave -> quiet release

stems.title: Focus Clean Engine 001
stems.designIntent: A clean, upright focus engine built from low harmonic repetition rather than white noise, traffic, fan, or room-tone masking.
stems.structure: clean low pulse -> stable workbed -> restrained harmonic motion -> sustained attention floor
